changes.title: Studio play
items: The treehouse Studio has a drum kit, a modular synth and a microphone: walk up to one and every key plays it (Esc steps away). Number keys 1 to 4 run the Studio's own loop and its tempo, 5 to 9 change the sound
The record shelf now stands on the Terrace beside your decks

changes.title: Roster biomes
items: The creatures are sorted into eight biomes, one for each point of the compass, and the islands on the sea chart move to match
The east of the sea chart is volcanic now: black basalt and lava lakes

changes.title: Map table slides
items: The map table's sea chart slides up as you walk to it, no button: it fills the screen with soft edges, the arrows, d-pad, right stick or mouse choose an island, and holding E (□ on a pad) or the mouse on it fills a ring and sails; walk on and it slides away
In the treehouse you can only take off from the Terrace
The sea chart has no Start over any more, and the island you're on can't be sailed to (the bed starts its next night)
